tags.name: วัดบางพูดนอก

_comment: DESIGN.md 1.4.2's ASCII rule, and the accent it used to get wrong. Four features: a plain road name, a name with an ACUTE ACCENT (Cafe Amazon, which is how OSM spells nearly every PTT branch), one with a MACRON (transliterated Thai), and a Thai name. The first three must be searchable after the NFKD fold; the fourth must still drop, because stripping combining marks from Thai leaves Thai. Before the fold, two of the four were invisible.
